verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Reclaim blocks flexible time for Tasks before their due dates, around everything else on the calendar, and splits long projects into chunks (reclaim-docs-32, reclaim-docs-7). It schedules by priority (reclaim-docs-33) and automatically reschedules when conflicts arise or meetings overbook lower-priority events (reclaim-docs-34, reclaim-docs-29), with users reporting they drag calendar blocks around less (reclaim-comm-4, reclaim-comm-10). missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specific to task auto-rescheduling (community reports are general and dated), detailed evidence of re-planning behavior when deadlines slip.
